quarterly_data.quarter: Microchip Technology press release: Build Smarter, More Resilient 48V Power Systems with (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Microchip announced the PAC1761 and PAC1861 families of 65V energy-aware digital power monitors for 48V power architectures, offering up-to-65V measurement and 75V of spike protection plus programmable alerts for voltage, current and power excursions, step-limit detection and configurable accumulated-energy thresholds. The 12-bit PAC1761 and 16-bit PAC1861 options come in VDFN-8, VDFN-10 and MSOP-10 packages including automotive-orderable variants, with pin-compatible options. Target applications include automotive, AI/data center, networking, industrial, server, telecom/Power over Ethernet (PoE) and 48V power distribution systems. The families are available now starting at $0.56 each in 10,000-unit quantities (PAC1761T-3E/E3 and PAC1861T-1E/3P, both MSOP-10); the EV12R33A evaluation board is priced at $49.00.

quarterly_data.quarter: Microchip Technology press release: Microchip Technology Completes Acquisition of Hailo (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Microchip completed its acquisition of Hailo, a provider of accelerated edge AI processors, vision processors, robotics processors and AI software technologies, adding AI accelerators and vision processors to its portfolio for Edge AI, machine vision, robotics and Physical AI applications. The terms of the transaction were not disclosed, and the transaction is not expected to have a material impact on Microchip's financial results. Hailo brings more than 100 customers and an active developer community exceeding 10,000 users; Microchip plans to continue supporting Hailo's existing product portfolio, software environment and customer engagements.
quarterly_data.figure: terms not disclosed; not expected to have a material impact on financial results; Hailo: more than 100 customers, developer community exceeding 10,000 users
